latest_release.body:
## :warning: Noteworthy
- **Atlas FunctionTimer behavior change**: `AtlasMeterRegistry` now publishes `FunctionTimer` statistics (`count` and `totalTime`) as per-second rates instead of gauges ([#8108](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/8108)). With the default 1-minute step, published values will be ~60x lower than before; any dashboard queries or alert rules dividing by 60 should be updated. See the [1.18 Migration Guide](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/wiki/1.18-Migration-Guide#atlas-functiontimer-statistics-published-as-rates) for details.
- Deprecate for removal the registry for EOL AppOptics [#7954](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/7954)
- Remove EOL and deprecated Wavefront module [#7625](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/7625)
- Make inclusion of `LongTaskTimer` by `DefaultMeterObservationHandler` opt-in instead of opt-out [#7312](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/7312)
- State objects should not be nullable for function-based meter registration [#6416](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/6416)
- Replace the OpenTelemetry protobuf library [#5658](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/5658)
- Add config option to compress Datadog payload [#2297](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/2297)

## :star: New Features

- Support fractional updates for Atlas counters [#8109](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/8109)
- Send the Datadog API keys in the headers [#7894](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/7894)
- Update MultiGauge Gauges instead of remove/add [#7851](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/7851)
- Prometheus: reduce allocations for histogram buckets [#7838](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/7838)
- Skip registering Hazelcast meters when statistics are not enabled [#7568](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/7568)
- Include HTTP/2 GlobalRequestProcessor MBean in TomcatMetrics [#7535](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/7535)
- Introduce per-convention meter convention types and builder pattern [#7369](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/7369)
- Add Gauges for memory pool usage after GC [#7296](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/7296)
- Configure a custom JmsProcessObservationConvention or JmsPublishObservationConvention [#5492](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/5492)
- Optimize PrometheusMeterRegistry and MicrometerCollector snapshot collection [#7802](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/7802)
- Skip registering JCache meters when statistics are not enabled [#7562](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/7562)
- Fail collision validation at registration instead of at scrape with typed Prometheus family descriptors [#7487](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/7487)
- Prometheus: unnecessary allocation and validation performed on every scrape [#7450](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/7450)
- Bump Kotlin target from 1.8 to 2.0 [#7338](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/7338)
- Add option for time-based FunctionCounter [#7329](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/7329)
- Remove lastScope field and deprecated implementations from SimpleObservation [#7273](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/7273)
- Replace the OpenTelemetry protobuf library [#5658](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/5658)
- KeyValue support for Observation.Event [#5238](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/5238)
- Add config option to compress Datadog payload [#2297](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/2297)

- Missing reflection hint for getProcessCpuTime [#7911](https://github.com/micromet

# Micrometer Application Metrics

[![Build Status](https://circleci.com/gh/micrometer-metrics/micrometer.svg?style=shield)](https://circleci.com/gh/micrometer-metrics/micrometer)
[![Apache 2.0](https://img.shields.io/github/license/micrometer-metrics/micrometer.svg)](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0)
[![Maven Central](https://img.shields.io/maven-central/v/io.micrometer/micrometer-core.svg)](https://search.maven.org/artifact/io.micrometer/micrometer-core)
[![Javadocs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Javadocs-orange)](https://javadocs.dev/io.micrometer)
[![Revved up by Develocity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Revved%20up%20by-Develocity-06A0CE?logo=Gradle&labelColor=02303A)](https://ge.spring.io)

An application metrics facade for the most popular monitoring tools. Instrument your code with dimensional metrics with a
vendor-neutral interface and decide on the monitoring backend at the last minute.

More info on [micrometer.io](https://micrometer.io).

Micrometer artifacts work with Java 8 or later with a few exceptions such as the micrometer-java11 module and micrometer-jetty11.

## Supported versions

See [Micrometer's support policy](https://micrometer.io/support/).

## Join the discussion

Join the [Micrometer Slack](https://slack.micrometer.io) to share your questions, concerns, and feature requests.

## Snapshot builds

Snapshots are published to `repo.spring.io` for every successful build on the `main` branch and maintenance branches.

To use:

```groovy
repositories {
    maven { url 'https://repo.spring.io/snapshot' }
}

dependencies {
    implementation 'io.micrometer:micrometer-core:latest.integration'
}
```

## Milestone releases

Starting with the 1.15.0-M2 release, milestone releases and release candidates will be published to Maven Central.
Note that milestone releases are for testing purposes and are not intended for production use.

## Documentation

The reference documentation is managed in the [docs directory](/docs) and published to https://micrometer.io/.

## Samples/Examples

You can find sample/example apps in the [micrometer-samples](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer-samples) repository.

## Contributing

See our [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) for information about contributing to Micrometer.
